study.question: Does retaining observed match-group event proportions during within-group target-conditioned retrieval expose incremental utility beyond the stronger global pooled-capacity control, both frozen source bests, and a query-only target-independent replacement?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: equal mass per occupied match group is not the empirical event distribution. Thus the previous raw-uniform readout is a mean of group means, whereas the current pooled_reference is an event-weighted mean. g3-r0019-raw_target AUC=0.6307203236894126 beats raw_context=0.6303822658190372 and raw_uniform=0.630259626350387, but is below g3-r0020-pooled_reference=0.6307714974815276. Radius-only target AUC=0.6306798923499843 also fails to beat that reference despite better Logloss. This motivates, but does not prove, a group-allocation explanation: equal weighting may amplify small match groups and offset useful learned within-group evidence. Replace only group prior mass 1/K by n_g/N, keeping each group softmax. Constant scores now reconstruct the global pooled vector. Predicted utility must exceed the new empirical-uniform control, the frozen stronger pooled_reference and both source bests, and survive the empirical-context and historical active duplicated-evidence controls. Query and mass effects may interact; existing equal-mass target/context/uniform cells supply the other factorial level. All prior comparisons are single-seed observations, not established mechanism evidence.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit candidate-ad-conditioned local relevance and field interaction scoring through the existing adapted baseline. DIN removes softmax to retain interest intensity; this proposal retains normalized within-group softmax and total mass one, fixes group masses to observed fractions, and preserves the full pooled predictor. It is not an exact DIN reproduction or a claim of new attention.

The candidate inherits every ancestor class verbatim. The final Model overrides only grouped mass allocation and diagnostics; no parameters are allocated. Target/context/uniform keep their original queries, scoring, raw scale and fusion head. Compared with raw_target, the sole mathematical intervention is empirical rather than occupied-group-uniform prior.

Its strongest result uses only a duplicated global pooled vector, with scorer contribution and gradients zero. New empirical_uniform reconstructs that vector algebraically with the same allocation and head; target/context enable learned within-group deviations around this nested null. Floating-point reduction and gradient arithmetic differ, so the new null is trained rather than assuming identical checkpoints.

Retain the complete stronger source representation and residuals; the existing fusion head adds capacity and a readout. The empirical-uniform cell tests that extra capacity using existing evidence; gains over the frozen source alone do not establish target-conditioned complementarity.

Retain this frozen target-readout source best as a utility comparator. Its equal match-group mass is examined rather than mandated. The new branch is fitted jointly with the complete stronger pooled representation; cross-architecture performance is not a single-factor mechanism estimate.

Considered query-generation cross attention and packed domain retrieval. Neither new queries, views, domain supervision nor optimization recipe is adopted: local evidence first motivates a mass-allocation control. Source pCVR, item/dense fields and row-group split differ from this task.

Only README lines 4-8 are verified: category/brand/behavior histories have no item IDs. No item features, retrieval targets or auxiliary labels are introduced. Publisher full text is unavailable; no detailed DMR equivalence or priority claim is made.

study.proposed_difference: For group g with n_g valid events and N total, replace w_i=(1/K)*exp(s_i)/sum_{j in g} exp(s_j) by w_i=(n_g/N)*exp(s_i)/sum_{j in g} exp(s_j), with zero mass for empty groups/histories. Each occupied group retains its empirical event fraction regardless of scores, so the candidate learns only within-group relevance. Category and brand retain separate weights and share half of their mass on action/recency values. No learned prior, additional gate, parameter, information, loss or optimizer change. The algebra nests the global pooled null when scores are constant. Newness relative to broader literature remains unverified; this is a mechanism-distinct local allocation replacement.
predictions: Implementation: group weight mass equals n_g/N, masked events have zero mass, nonempty total weight is one; independent per-group loop oracle agrees; uniform summary equals the existing global pool. Empty/zero-length outputs remain finite, singleton readouts equal their pool, and padding/order invariance holds within floating-point tolerance.

Primary utility prediction: empirical_target exceeds empirical_uniform, g3-r0020-pooled_reference, g1-r0019-pooled_observed (0.6302753100663608) and g3-r0007-balanced_target (0.6202303848951921) on full-population validation ROC-AUC. Report unweighted Logloss separately; an AUC/Logloss tradeoff is not hidden.

Target-conditioning prediction: empirical_target exceeds empirical_context with equal allocation and measured cost; context changes only query construction and retains target-dependent match partitions. Comparison to uniform is essential to test utility beyond existing evidence.

Allocation prediction: empirical_target minus g3-r0019-raw_target is positive; compare this with empirical_context minus g3-r0019-raw_context and empirical_uniform minus g3-r0019-raw_uniform. The difference of target-context gaps between prior levels tests interaction; do not infer an allocation mechanism solely from a candidate-source gain.

Existing history-length, hour, behavior-composition and train-frequency slices are exploratory robustness checks, with their supplied sample/positive/negative counts. The dominant >64-history slice contains 3,026,583 impressions and 151,372 positives; inspect it and small/empty histories without changing global selection or cherry-picking bins. No new frequency or missing-field bins can be fabricated from unavailable raw data.

Host measures parameters, train and allocated GPU seconds if supplied, wall time, peak memory, examples processed if supplied, inference throughput and batch p50/p95 latency. This replacement predicts no meaningful complexity increase; any equal-compute efficiency claim requires measured cost, not matched recipe alone.
falsifiers: Reject implementation validity if per-group mass or uniform-to-global-pool identity fails beyond numerical tolerance, or outputs/diagnostics are nonfinite. Record failed receipt and cost before any corrected proposal; do not launch a duplicate unknown-state run.
If empirical_target does not improve over empirical_uniform and the stronger pooled_reference, incremental utility is unsupported even if it exceeds both original source bests.
If empirical_context matches the candidate, target-query-specific explanation is unsupported; retained target-defined grouping prevents claiming a fully target-independent control.
If allocation helps uniform/context as much as target, it supports distribution weighting or optimization rather than target-conditioned complementarity; compare the full prior-by-query contrasts.

If the historical active duplicated-evidence control g3-r0019-raw_pooled_duplicate or the exact pooled null explains the gain, capacity/recombination remains a sufficient explanation. The active duplicate has different granularity and cost, so its failure alone cannot establish mechanism.

If effects reverse across paired seeds or paired user-cluster uncertainty includes no gain, retain preliminary/null status. One seed or checkpoint sensitivity cannot establish a mechanism or significance.
If quality gains require materially more measured compute or worsen Logloss, report the tradeoff; do not claim simultaneous accuracy and efficiency improvement.
alternative_explanations: All observed AUC differences are small single-seed results subject to checkpoint selection, rounding, shared-validation adaptation and training variance. The same seed and data order do not eliminate these risks.

Pooled_reference already outperforms raw_target, while radius_target has better Logloss; neither raw direction nor scalar norm has demonstrated unique predictive sufficiency. Added nonlinear readout capacity and changed optimization can explain gains over the original pooled source.

The empirical prior also reduces minority match-group amplification; benefits may reflect regularization or population composition rather than improved semantic retrieval. This proposal does not assume rare groups are noisy without measuring them.

Context queries ignore current-target embeddings only at query construction. All learned cells still use target-dependent match membership and static features. Uniform empirical weights cancel this grouping algebraically, but the complete classifier still receives target fields.

An active duplicated-evidence control has equal allocated scorer capacity but different softmax support and event granularity, and is faster. It is complementary evidence, not a perfect isolation of active event-level attention capacity.

Synthetic witness separation and checkpoint substitution are implementation/sensitivity checks, not a causal estimate of predictive benefit. Diagnostic coverage is only the first 512 validation impressions.

Static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented. Inputs lack item IDs and the supplied history is truncated to 128. Validation-only findings do not establish production point-in-time or held-out test generalization.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Three registered full-protocol variants, including both controls, expected 3300s total (worst case three trial caps=5282.7973s). cost_plan.stop_rule: Treat the host ledger and per-trial cap as hard limits; never raise them. Recheck remaining budget after every receipt, including preparation/failure charges, and prioritize final attribution repetitions over new directions. If actual unit costs approach the cap, the nominal six-run repetition reserve cannot hold: reduce optional scope and disclose omitted seeds, not budget. Stop immediately for nonfinite/contract-invalid behavior or unknown execution state pending a receipt. Do not retry an unknown-state job. If no useful admissible comparison fits, preserve the incumbent and report preliminary/null evidence. A poor empirical_target may still justify its two predeclared controls to distinguish allocation failure from query redundancy; no automatic second architecture sweep.
